title: holosteum umbellatum subsp. glutinosum
intro: Holosteum umbellatum subsp. glutinosum, commonly known as Sticky Cranesbill or Sticky Hollyhock, is a plant species within the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant is rich in bioactive constituents and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Holosteum umbellatum subsp. glutinosum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
